reviews.title: Not the best weather app

reviews.title: Baot and switch trial?
reviews.text:
I’d love to give this 5 stars but I detest bait and switch “free” trials.

I got to look at the app ONCE before I was met with a “thanks for your subscription, enter your Apple ID to activate and begin using the app.” I am paraphrasing, but that’s the gist. 

It appears that if you accept the “free trial” you are then rushed to be charged for the yearly subscription before you can access the app.

Now, in fairness, it’s a little ambiguous so MAYBE you don’t get immediately charged. I’m not going to play roulette and then have to go to Apple support to try to get my money back. Too much hassle. Played this subscription game more times than I can count. Been there. Done that. Got the t-shirt. 

So my advice is, if you are not ready to pay the $20/yr, decline that and they will offer you a yearly subscription for $11.99. Be prepared to pay that depiste offer of Schrödinger’s free trial.

Or roll the dice. But when I have to play When and How Much Am I Gonna’ Be Charged, I’ll choose Never. Too bad, because in the few minutes I got to look at it, it was a cute app that I might have really liked.

reviews.title: Rip off app
reviews.text: After paying $19.99, you find out that you only get partial features and ads everywhere!

reviews.title: Bad AI
reviews.text: Images and descriptions are AIed. Someone actually told it that cats talk like sailors, so it constantly says stuff like "ar matey" and "batten down the hatches." You also can't use most of its features, so if you want to know about wind, humidity, "feels like" temp etc you have to pay a subscription. Which is a waste of money when you can get all that info for free, you just don't get an AIed cat with pirate talk.

reviews.title: Misleading, is not for free
reviews.text: I just don’t like the fact that it’s advertise for free, and then we download it and it’s actually a subscription to unlock key features to keeping you and your family safe during a storm. Such as feature radar that allows you to see where a storm is heading they can give you minutes and hours to get your family to safety. Removing the app.

reviews.title: Tricks you into paying!
reviews.text: I can’t even say if I like this app, since they instantly want your money, before you can try the app. No way! Forget that!

reviews.title: Overboard with ads
reviews.text: This used to be a cute app to get the weather but now it is paywalls and ads galore. They make it impossible to close the ad without clicking on it. After using this app for several years, I finally had to delete it. I get that you need ad revenue but don’t make the app unusable.
